payload.stories:
S1 - THE CLEAN CLOSE (killer). Realizes prop 1 and prop 2. s1: an iteration has walked its milestones in its own worktree and reaches the ship gate. s2: the agent closes it; SE tags the branch iter/<id> first. s3: SE merges the branch into trunk, keeping both parents, and drops the event paths from the merge's tree before committing. s4: trunk now shows the iteration's ledger nodes, its tests and its product code - and no evidence directory, no machines directory, no state.json. s5 recap: the reader sees only live claims, and the record is one tag away. Evidence side: empty until validation.

S2 - THE AUDIT A YEAR LATER (killer). Realizes prop 2. s1: someone asks on what evidence a shipped iteration blessed its build gate. s2: they read the grant on trunk, which names the iteration, the state, the hash and the evidence path. s3: the path is not in the working tree. s4: they follow the pointer to the tag and git show iter/<id>:<path> returns the evidence document unchanged. s5 recap: nothing was lost by leaving trunk clean.

S3 - THE INTERRUPTED ITERATION. Realizes prop 3. s1: an iteration is three milestones in. s2: each of those milestones committed to its branch as it was blessed. s3: the machine dies, or the worktree is removed by mistake. s4: the branch still holds every committed milestone, and re-provisioning the worktree restores the work. s5 recap: losing a working directory costs nothing.

S4 - THE SHIP THAT REFUSES (killer). Realizes prop 4. s1: an iteration reaches its close having committed nothing to its branch. s2: SE compares the branch against its fork point and finds no commits. s3: the close REFUSES with a named clause instead of merging an empty branch. s4: the agent is told plainly that there is nothing to ship. s5 recap: the process can no longer report success while the repository records nothing - the exact i8c failure.

S5 - THE ARCHIVE STAYS VISIBLE. Realizes the folded no-regression need. s1: an iteration closes and its evidence leaves trunk's working tree. s2: the owner opens the board. s3: the closed iteration still appears in the iteration list, sourced from the grant index. s4: its detail is not yet readable from git - that is i5e - but it has not vanished. s5 recap: cleaning trunk did not erase the iteration from view.

S6 - THE WORKTREE THAT CAN VERIFY ITSELF. Realizes the provisioning half. s1: a new iteration is opened and its worktree is provisioned. s2: the agent runs the full verify. s3: the typecheck resolves its toolchain and the battery runs against an engine that matches trunk. s4: green, with no manual patching. s5 recap: a fresh worktree is verifiable on the first try.
